propositions.name: aether_pervaded_by_electrons
propositions.statement: The material system consists of free aether pervaded by a system of electrons which are to be treated individually.
propositions.quote: We shall now consider the material system as consisting of free aether pervaded by a system of electrons which are to be treated individually

propositions.name: electrons_grouped_into_molecules
propositions.statement: The great majority of electrons are grouped into material molecules.
propositions.quote: but the great majority of them grouped into material molecules

propositions.name: aether_dynamics_independently_ascertained
propositions.statement: The dynamical equations of the aether have been definitely ascertained in independent ways from consideration of both the optical side and the electrodynamic side of its activity.
propositions.quote: whose dynamical equations have been definitely ascertained in quite independent ways from consideration of both the optical side and the electrodynamic side of its activity

propositions.name: electron_as_singular_point
propositions.statement: An electron occurs in the analysis as a singular point in the aether at which the elastic strain constituting the aethereal displacement increases indefinitely.
propositions.quote: An electron e will occur in this analysis as a singular point in the aether, on approaching which the elastic strain constituting the aethereal displacement

propositions.name: singularity_is_definite_structure
propositions.statement: The singularity of the electron represents a definite structure, forming a nucleus of strain in the aether which is capable of transference across the aether independently of motion of the aether itself.
propositions.quote: It is assumed that this singularity represents a definite structure, forming a nucleus of strain in the aether, which is capable of transference across that medium independently of motion of the aether itself

propositions.name: strain_nucleus_carried_with_electron
propositions.statement: The strain associated with the electron is carried along with the electron in its motion.
propositions.quote: which is associated with the electron and is carried along with the electron in its motion, being as above

propositions.name: electron_energy_concentrated
propositions.statement: The energy of the displacement associated with the electron is closely concentrated around the nucleus of the electron and not widely diffused.
propositions.quote: the energy of this part of the displacement is closely concentrated around the nucleus of the electron, and not widely diffused as might at first sight appear

propositions.name: stream_condition_except_at_electrons
propositions.statement: The aethereal displacement satisfies the stream-condition except where there are electrons in the effective element of volume, analogous to sources and sinks in the theory of liquid flow.
propositions.quote: except where there are electrons in the effective element of volume: these are analogous to the so-called sources and sinks in the abstract theory of liquid flow

propositions.name: electron_charge_as_flux_integral
propositions.statement: When electrons are present, the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement over the boundary of any region is equal to the quantity of electrons existing in the region.
propositions.quote: the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement over the boundary of any region, instead of being null, is equal to the quantity Σe of electrons existing in the region

propositions.name: magnetic_induction_no_simple_poles
propositions.statement: The magnetic induction possesses the stream property, but singular points of the nature of simple poles do not exist in its distribution.
propositions.quote: namely the magnetic induction ( a, b, c ), also possesses the stream property; but singular points in its distribution, of the nature of simple poles, do not exist

propositions.name: electron_motion_causes_rotational_singularity
propositions.statement: The motion of an electron involves a singularity in the magnetic induction, of a rotational type, with its nucleus at the moving electron.
propositions.quote: The motion of an electron involves however a singularity in ( a, b, c ), of a rotational type, with its nucleus at the moving electron

propositions.name: orbital_motion_as_magnetic_doublet
propositions.statement: The time-average of the rotational singularity for a rapid minute steady orbital motion of an electron is analytically equivalent, at distances considerable compared with the dimensions of the orbit, to a magnetic doublet.
propositions.quote: the time-average of this singularity for a very rapid minute steady orbital motion of an electron is analytically equivalent, at distances considerable compared with the dimensions of the orbit, to a magnetic doublet

propositions.name: aether_elements_sensibly_at_rest
propositions.statement: The various parts of the aether are supposed to be sensibly at rest, so the time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to time.
propositions.quote: the various parts of the aether are supposed to be sensibly at rest, so that for example the time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to the time

propositions.name: aether_equations_linear
propositions.statement: The equations of the aether are much simpler than those of the dynamics of fluid motion, being in fact linear.
propositions.quote: in this respect the equations of the aether are much simpler than those of the dynamics of fluid motion, being in fact linear

propositions.name: aether_stagnant
propositions.statement: The aether is stagnant, and the molecules constituting the Earth and all other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it.
propositions.quote: The aether is stagnant on this theory, while the molecules constituting the Earth and all other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it

propositions.name: aberration_rigorously_maintained
propositions.statement: The law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained.
propositions.quote: the law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained

propositions.name: doppler_change_holds_good
propositions.statement: The Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good.
propositions.quote: the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good

propositions.name: terrestrial_optics_unaffected_by_earth_motion
propositions.statement: All purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion.
propositions.quote: but it will appear that all purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion

propositions.name: c_single_physical_constant
propositions.statement: c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it.
propositions.quote: c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it

propositions.name: maxwell_maccullagh_equations_same
propositions.statement: The equations derived by Maxwell in his development of Faraday's views are the same as the equations arrived at by MacCullagh in his formulation of the dynamics of optical media.
propositions.quote: they are the same as the equations arrived at by MacCullagh a quarter of a century earlier in his formulation of the dynamics of optical media

propositions.name: formulation_exactness_unsurpassed
propositions.statement: The analytical formulation of the dynamical relations of free aether has an exactness and precision not surpassed in any other department of physics, even in the theory of gravitation.
propositions.quote: have imparted to this analytical formulation of the dynamical relations of free aether an exactness and precision which is not surpassed in any other department of physics, even in the theory of gravitation

propositions.name: state_determines_future_state
propositions.statement: From a knowledge of the state of the system at any time t, the state at the time t plus a small interval can be immediately expressed.
propositions.quote: from a knowledge of the state of the system at any time t the state at the time t + δt can be immediately expressed

propositions.name: aether_scheme_determines_electron_motion
propositions.statement: The solution of the equations in terms of a given initial state of the system determines the motions of the electrons through the medium as well as the changes of strain in the medium itself.
propositions.quote: whether the solution of these equations in terms of a given initial state of the system determines the motions of the electrons or strain-nuclei through the medium, as well as the changes of strain in the medium itself

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_labile
propositions.statement: The nucleus of the electron is quite labile as regards displacement through the aether, its movement not influenced by any inertia or forces except such as are the expression of its relation to the aether.
propositions.quote: This however presupposes that the nucleus of the electron is quite labile as regards displacement through the aether, in other words that its movement is not influenced by any inertia or forces

propositions.name: electron_treated_as_point
propositions.statement: So long as the actual dimensions of the nuclei of electrons are extremely small in comparison with the distances between them, it will suffice for the theory to consider them as points.
propositions.quote: so long as the actual dimensions of their nuclei are extremely small in comparison with the distances between them, it will suffice for the theory to consider them as points

propositions.name: atoms_are_electron_aggregations
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, and the only actions between atoms are electric forces.
propositions.quote: in which atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, the only actions between atoms are what may be described as electric forces

propositions.name: chemical_affinity_electric_character
propositions.statement: The electric character of the forces of chemical affinity was an accepted part of the chemical views, and more recent discussions have tended to the strengthening of that hypothesis.
propositions.quote: The electric character of the forces of chemical affinity was an accepted part of the chemical views of Davy, Berzelius, and Faraday; and more recent discussions, while clearing away crude conceptions, have invariably tended to the strengthening of that hypothesis

propositions.name: vortex_ring_dynamical_properties
propositions.statement: The atom of matter possesses all the dynamical properties of a vortex ring in a frictionless fluid.
propositions.quote: the atom of matter possesses all the dynamical properties of a vortex ring in a frictionless fluid, so that everything that can be done in the domain of vortex-ring illustration is implicitly attached to the present scheme

propositions.name: aether_equations_apply_to_moving_axes
propositions.statement: The equations of the free aether hold when changing from axes at rest in the aether to axes moving with translatory velocity v parallel to the axis of x.
propositions.quote: changing from axes ( x, y, z ) at rest in the aether to axes (x', y', z') moving with translatory velocity v parallel to the axis of x

propositions.name: epsilon_second_order_deviation
propositions.statement: The factor epsilon only differs from unity by a quantity of the second order.
propositions.quote: It is to be observed that this factor ε only differs from unity by

propositions.name: identical_system_in_motion_exists
propositions.statement: Given any system of electrified bodies at rest in equilibrium under their mutual electric influences and imposed constraints, there is a precisely identical system in equilibrium under the same constraints in uniform translatory motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: given any system of electrified bodies at rest, in equilibrium under their mutual electric influences and imposed constraints, there will be a precisely identical system in equilibrium under the same constraints, and in uniform translatory motion through the aether

propositions.name: motion_no_first_order_effect_on_distributions
propositions.statement: Uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned.
propositions.quote: uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned

propositions.name: result_independent_of_molecular_force_theory
propositions.statement: The result that motion through the aether does not alter electric distributions to the first order is independent of any theory as to the nature of the forces between material molecules.
propositions.quote: this result is independent of any theory as to the nature of the forces between material molecules: the structure of the matter being assumed unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether

propositions.name: no_new_forces_required_for_moving_configuration
propositions.statement: If a configuration of ionic charges is the natural one in a material system at rest, the maintenance of the same configuration in the system in uniform motion will not require the aid of any new forces.
propositions.quote: if any configuration of ionic charges is the natural one in a material system at rest, the maintenance of the same configuration as regards the system in uniform motion will not require the aid of any new forces

propositions.name: electron_is_simple_singularity_on_any_theory
propositions.statement: The electron taken by itself must be, on any conceivable theory, a simple singularity of the aether whose movements when free, and interactions with other electrons when constrained by matter, are governed through the aether.
propositions.quote: The electron taken by itself must be on any conceivable theory a simple singularity of the aether whose movements when it is free, and interactions with other electrons if it can be constrained by matter

propositions.name: displacements_differ_to_first_order
propositions.statement: Though the fixed and the moving system of electrons are at corresponding instants identical, the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order.
propositions.quote: though the fixed and the moving system of electrons of this correlation are at corresponding instants identical, yet the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order

propositions.name: dielectric_transformation_media_dependent
propositions.statement: The transformation of the equations applies to any isotropic dielectric medium as well as to free aether, altering c into the velocity of radiation in that medium, and the transformation is different for different media.
propositions.quote: the above analytical transformation of the equations applies to any isotropic dielectric medium as well as to free aether: we have only to alter c into the velocity of radiation in that medium, and all will be as above

propositions.name: moving_dielectric_alters_current_type
propositions.statement: The motion of the polarized dielectric matter alters the mathematical type of the electric current, so that a moving material system treated as continuous cannot be directly compared with the same system at rest.
propositions.quote: we are arrested if we attempt to proceed to compare a moving material system, treated as continuous, with the same system at rest; for the motion of the polarized dielectric matter has altered the mathematical type of the electric current

propositions.name: electrons_equal_strength_across_systems
propositions.statement: The electrons in the two compared systems are of equal strengths, since very near an electron, fixed or moving, the values of the vectors are practically those due to it.

propositions.name: charge_amount_equals_boundary_flux_integral
propositions.statement: The amount of electricity inside any boundary is equal to the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement taken over the boundary.
propositions.quote: the amount of electricity inside any boundary is equal to the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement taken over the boundary
